response.overview: Ava leaves her hometown behind to start over as a gig-delivery driver for "DoorZipp" in a new city. However, a routine delivery trap leads her straight into the clutches of a local, cannibalistic community. Kidnapped and marked as the secret ingredient for the town's famous stew, Ava realizes the amulet her best friend forced her to wear is a cage for her own darkest secret. When the cannibals strip it away, they unknowingly make the final, fatal mistake of their lives.
response.title: Moonlight Amulet
